observations: Read and looked at assets/panels/05-3.png, main-cast.png, page-05.png and the '05-3 ravi' crop on page-05-faces-200.png.

Doctor's-head edit: the upper-left area is clean plain white wall. I found no hair, shoulder or outline remnant of the removed back of Ananya's head. That plain area holds Ravi's balloon in the composite.

Ravi faces screen-left toward the doctor. His right hand, on the viewer's left, rubs the back of his neck with the rolled sleeve shown. His left hand, on the viewer's right, rests on his knee with the wristwatch on that wrist. This matches production and keeps the watch consistent with 05-1, 05-2 and 06-2. The face matches the sheet: beard, thick brows, eyes creasing at the corners.

Acting: his raised brows and open, sheepish smile with eyes glancing aside read as candid and slightly embarrassed. It is lighter than 'tired', but it suits a routine concern and implies nothing medical.

Screen: four stacked light blocks with person, clipboard-tick, chat and document icons, plus a row of three coloured chips on the left. A glowing teal microphone with sound-wave arcs sits in the right third. No letters, numbers or real data and nothing diagnostic. In the composite the SOAP label sits over the left blocks and the microphone stays visible.

Non-blocking spatial note: a window with a potted plant appears behind Ravi on the right, while 05-1 and 05-4 put the window behind Ananya. This reads acceptably as a side-wall window. His chair has blue upholstery with wooden arms, a little different from the blue frame in 05-1.
